much of them as may be valid and to enact law relating to Courts in Punjab,

3. Definitions.‑
In this Part, unless there is something repugnant in the subject or context:
(1) "Small cause" means
a suit of the nature cognizable by a court of small causes under the Provincial
Small Cause Courts Act, 1887.
(2) "Land suit" means a
suit relating to land as defined in section 4 (1) of the Punjab Tenancy Act,
1887, or to any right or interest in such land;
(3) "Unclassed suit"
means a suit which is neither small cause nor a land suit ; and
(4) "Value" used with
reference to a suit means the amount or value of the subject matter of the
suit.
